verdict.rationale: Zulip documents built-in message search with a 'wide array of search filters' that combine with keywords. Only the channel filter and an all-public-channels scope are shown concretely; sender and date filters are not evidenced, and neither is admin access to the full history (including private messages). missing for 10: documented sender filter, documented date-range filter, explicit full-history/admin-scope search, independent hands-on corroboration of search quality.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can search the full message history with filters like sender, channel, and date

citations.quote: Zulip also offers a wide array of search filters, which can be used on their own, or in combination with keywords.
channel:design has:image new logo: Search for messages in #design that include an image and contain the keywords new and logo.
channels:public: Search messages in all public and web-public channels.
